title: Choose a specific, plain-language update
prompt:
Choose the most accurate customer update. Source: package delayed; next status update at 15:00 UTC today; delivery time unknown. A: We are leveraging synergies for a seamless journey. B: Your package is delayed. We will update you today at 15:00 UTC. Delivery time is not confirmed. C: Your package will arrive today at 15:00 UTC.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. selected: A, B, or C.
remediation_hints: Use concrete language and preserve the difference between an update time and delivery time.
